summary: Example inventory with `[automationcontroller]`, `[automationhub]`, `[automationedacontroller]`, `[automationgateway]` and `[database]`, plus `automationedacontroller_admin_password` and `automationedacontroller_pg_host`/`_port`/`_database`/`_username`/`_password` alongside the controller and hub database variables; `sso_keystore_password` is shown for HTTPS SSO.

answer_card.title: Add EDA controller to the RPM inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[automationedacontroller]
automationedacontroller.example.com

[all:vars]
automationedacontroller_admin_password='<eda-password>'
automationedacontroller_pg_host='data.example.com'
automationedacontroller_pg_port=5432
automationedacontroller_pg_database='automationedacontroller'
automationedacontroller_pg_username='automationedacontroller'
automationedacontroller_pg_password='<password>'
```
EDA must be on its own host.
